subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed before mutating-tool handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: The PR's stated suppress-all policy conflicts with existing detail-warning tests, and an automated repair cannot safely choose which user-visible warning contract maintainers want.

options.title: Suppress exec-like first
options.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and update focused tests to prove that includeDetails does not make exec-like warnings visible.

options.title: Preserve detail warnings
options.body: Keep current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail behavior and narrow or close the linked report as an overbroad policy request.

options.title: Pause for live proof
options.body: Keep the branch open until the contributor shows redacted real behavior proof for the exact warning leak and proposed suppression.

recommendation.title: Suppress exec-like first
recommendation.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and update focused tests to prove that includeDetails does not make exec-like warnings visible.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the shared tool mutation and warning-policy surfaces affected by the decision.
